Metadata.title: Sufra | Find a restaurant and book your table
Metadata.description: See restaurants' menus and hours and book your table online. Own a restaurant? Build its website with Sufra in minutes.

Site.name: Sufra
Site.footerTagline: Find a restaurant, see the menu and book your table.

Home.eyebrow: Restaurants and bookings in one place
Home.title: Find a restaurant and book your table
Home.lead: See the menu and hours, pick a day and a time, and your table is confirmed right away, without a phone call.
Home.ownerBody: Build your restaurant's website in minutes and take bookings through it.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.heading: We couldn't find that page
NotFound.body: The link may have a typo, or the page was removed.

Restaurant.bookBody: Online booking is coming soon. Until then, give us a call and we'll set up your table.

Restaurant.errorBody: We couldn't show this page right now. Please try again in a moment.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.emptyBody: Set up your first restaurant site in minutes: a name, an address and your color.
Dashboard.categories: {count, plural, =0 {No sections} one {# section} other {# sections}}
Dashboard.createLead: This shows on your restaurant's site. You can change it later in settings.

fields.name: Restaurant name
fields.slugHint: Shown in the link after <path>/r/</path>. It can't change once the restaurant exists.
fields.timesHint: Riyadh time. You can set each day and two periods in settings once the restaurant is created.
fields.accentHint: Your whole site's colors come from it, with contrast adjusted for you.

MenuEditor.title: Menu
MenuEditor.lead: Reorder sections and dishes by dragging, or with the keyboard: Space to pick up, arrows to move.
MenuEditor.empty: The menu is empty. Start with a first section, like “Mains”.
MenuEditor.confirmCategory: Delete the “{name}” section? {count, plural, =0 {It has no dishes.} one {Its # dish goes too.} other {Its # dishes go too.}}

dnd.instructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up. Move with the arrow keys, then press Space or Enter to drop, or Escape to cancel.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Sufra

reset.subject: Reset your Sufra password
reset.preheader: A link to choose a new password.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: We got a request to reset the password for your account. If it was you, press the button and choose a new one.
reset.expires: This link works once, for one hour.

exists.preheader: Someone tried to sign up with your email.
exists.heading: You already have an account
exists.body: Someone tried to create a new account with this email, but it already has one. You can sign in now, or choose a new password if you've forgotten it.

proposalDeclined.heading: {name} declined the change
proposalDeclined.body: The booking stays at its original time. The time they declined is above. Their mobile: {phone}.

customerRequest.preheader: Accept or decline on the bookings page

customerRequest.body: Reason: {reason}. The requested time is above, and the booking only changes if you accept.

requestAccepted.subject: {restaurant} accepted your request

requestDeclined.subject: {restaurant} couldn't change your booking
requestDeclined.preheader: Your booking stays as it was
requestDeclined.heading: {restaurant} declined your request

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email on Sufra
emailChange.preheader: One more step and your email changes.
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email
emailChange.body: Press the button to make this the email of your Sufra account.
emailChange.expires: The link works for one hour, once.

emailChangedNotice.subject: Your Sufra email was changed
emailChangedNotice.preheader: If this wasn't you, act now.
emailChangedNotice.heading: Your account email changed
emailChangedNotice.body: Your Sufra account's email is now {email}. If you didn't do this, contact us right away.

restaurantClosed.subject: Your booking at {restaurant} was cancelled
restaurantClosed.preheader: The restaurant is no longer available
restaurantClosed.heading: Your booking at {restaurant} was cancelled
restaurantClosed.body: The restaurant is no longer on Sufra, so your booking was cancelled. You can find others.

restaurantSuspended.preheader: Your restaurant was suspended by Sufra
restaurantSuspended.heading: {restaurant} was suspended
restaurantSuspended.body: Reason: {reason}. It isn't visible and takes no new bookings; existing ones stay.

restaurantRestored.subject: {restaurant} is back
restaurantRestored.heading: The suspension on {restaurant} was lifted
restaurantRestored.body: Your restaurant is back as it was.

accountSuspended.subject: Your Sufra account was suspended

Account.title: My account
Account.name: Your name
Account.phoneHint: Filled in for you when you book

Account.noPasswordLead: You only sign in with Google right now. You can create a password through a link sent to your email.
Account.linkSent: We sent the link to your email

Account.googleLinked: Your account is linked to Google.

Schedule.title: Weekly hours
Schedule.lead: One or two periods a day, like noon to 4 PM and 7 PM to midnight.
Schedule.midnightHint: The last period can pass midnight: 7 PM to 1 AM ends an hour after midnight.
Schedule.applyToAll: Apply the first open day to all
Schedule.affectedTitle: {count, plural, one {A coming booking is} other {# coming bookings are}} now outside your hours. Nothing was cancelled; it is your call:
Schedule.exceptionsLead: Closed days like Eid, days without bookings, or different hours for a while, like Ramadan.

Status.hideConfirm: People won't see your restaurant until you show it again. Are you sure?
Status.hideWithBookings: {count, plural, one {You have a coming booking} other {You have # coming bookings}}. They stay, but nobody can make new ones. Are you sure?
Status.draftBody: Nobody can see it until you publish it.
Status.hiddenBody: People can't see it, and there are no new bookings.
Status.previewBanner: This preview is only for you. Links and buttons are off here.
Status.deleteLead: Permanent. Its site disappears, coming bookings are cancelled and their customers told, and nobody can take its address.
Status.deleteType: Type the restaurant address to confirm: {slug}
Status.suspendedTitle: Your restaurant was suspended by the platform
Status.suspendedBody: It isn't visible and takes no new bookings; existing ones stay. Contact Sufra to lift this.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.reasonHint: Sent to the account or restaurant owner, and kept in the log.
Admin.newOwnerHint: They become the only owner, and get an email.
Admin.adminProtected: This is an admin account, and can't be changed from the panel.

ForRestaurants.title: Your restaurant's website, ready in minutes
ForRestaurants.lead: A menu with photos you change yourself, a QR code for your tables, bookings without phone calls, and a site in Arabic and English.

site.title: A site with your name on it
site.body: Your own link, colors drawn from your restaurant's color, and pages in Arabic and English.

menu.title: A menu you control
menu.body: Add dishes and their photos, reorder them by dragging, mark what's sold out, and it updates right away.

booking.title: Optional table booking
booking.body: Set your seats and hours, and follow each day's bookings from your dashboard. Turn it off whenever you like.

qr.title: A QR code for your tables
qr.body: Download it or print it as a ready table card. It opens your site and menu right on your guest's phone.

details.title: Set up your restaurant
details.body: Its name, link, hours and color.

publish.title: Add the menu and publish
publish.body: As soon as you add a dish, you can publish your restaurant.

Photos.dishHint: A clear photo makes a dish more tempting. You can add it later.
Photos.sectionLead: They show on your site and in the restaurant list, and save right away.
Photos.coverHint: A wide photo of your place or food.
Photos.cropHelp: Drag the photo to adjust it. With the keyboard: arrows to move, + and - to zoom.

Qr.title: QR code
Qr.lead: Print it and put it on your tables. Your guests point their phone at it, and your site and menu open right away.
Qr.notPublished: Your restaurant isn't published yet, so this code opens a page that doesn't exist until you publish it.
Qr.language: Language the code opens your site in
Qr.testFirst: Try the code with your phone before printing a batch.
